text:
jen_marketing: hey @lia @noah — prepping the press deck and a short webinar slide. we need a clean, reproducible set of benchmark numbers for 3 models (small/med/large) across hosted vs dedicated. can runtime own the data collection and a quick validation pass? :pray:

sam_marketing: high level ask: 1) 99/95/50 p50 p90 token latency 2) tokens/sec throughput at target QPS 3) cost-per-1k-tokens estimate using current infra config 4) sample outputs for quality sanity. ideally CSV + short JSON summary.

lia_eng_runtime: we can do this. couple questions: which exact model IDs and quantization settings? and do you want seq length 512 or 1024? also do you want cold-cache or warmed-cache numbers?

jen_marketing: good q. pick these: small=model-x-small-v1 (fp16), med=model-x-base-quant (int8), large=model-x-large-v1 (fp16). seq length 512 for interactive flows, 1024 for batch. include both cold and warmed (warmed = after 20 warmup requests).

noah_runtime: note: for int8 we need to run on g5 + nvllc perf knobs. if marketing wants apples-to-apples, we should record hardware, kernel flags, and batch config. i'll add a run template.

lia_eng_runtime: plan: 1) create per-model run IDs and store raw logs in s3://redwood-marketing/bench-1771512345/ 2) produce CSVs with fields: run_id, model, quant, hw, batch_size, seq_len, qps_target, p50_ms, p90_ms, p99_ms, tokens_per_sec, cost_per_1k_tokens 3) attach sample prompts + outputs in results/ 4) mark any failing sanity checks (exceptions, OOMs, >2x variance).

sam_marketing: can we get a quick smoke by EOD? otherwise fine to have full run by Wed. need a short blurb for the deck with a single headline number.

lia_eng_runtime: smoke test yes — will run minimal QPS (5) across the three configs and post results here. full runs will be batch jobs taking ~2-4 hours each; expecting to finish Wed.

noah_runtime: posting run template below — please use exactly these env vars and the prompt pack (link). i'll spin up test infra this afternoon.

noah_runtime: ```bash
export BENCH_RUN_ID=mar_pressdeck_1771512345
export S3_PATH=s3://redwood-marketing/bench-1771512345/$BENCH_RUN_ID
./run_bench --model $MODEL_ID --quant $QUANT --seq 512 --qps 50 --duration 900 --batch 1 --out $S3_PATH/results.csv
```

benchbot: scheduled bench job mar_pressdeck_1771512345-1 queued on g5.allocated-7 at 2026-03-21T15:12:00Z

jen_marketing: perfect. one more ask — please tag which numbers are "warmed-cache" vs "cold-cache" and include short note on what "warmed" means in the README. also include the top-3 failure modes observed during the run for transparency.

lia_eng_runtime: got it. we'll also attach perf traces for any p99 outliers and provide a simple markdown README in the S3 path with methodology and command lines used.

sam_marketing: if the smoke passes, i'll draft a one-line headline (e.g., "Xx faster at Y cost") but will wait for exact numbers. can you ping me the CSV link when smoke done?

lia_eng_runtime: will ping here with the s3 link + a one-paragraph summary. starting smoke in ~30m.

jen_marketing: thanks team! :tada:
